Benrey is a full-stack marketing agency built for businesses that are done wasting time. We don’t pitch fairy tales. We don’t push theories. We analyse and execute.
 We handle everything from paid media and creative to SEO, ASO, content, PR, brand protection, ambassadorship and beyond - digital, print, and everything in between. If it moves the brand forward, if it makes an impact - we’re on it.
 We’re the team you call when **it needs to get done - right, fast, and without excuses.
 Interested? Let’s see if we’re a match!
 Job Overview: We are seeking a talented and experienced Motion Designer to join our dynamic creative team. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in motion graphics, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to bring ideas to life through innovative and engaging visual storytelling.
 Your key responsibilities will include:

• Create and design engaging motion graphics content for various platforms including social media, websites, and digital advertising.

• Create videos and animated banners, text, logo, character, or other kinds of animations to be used in videos, websites, emails, campaigns and other media.

• Collaborate closely with the creative team, including graphic designers, product designers, and content creators, to develop and execute concepts.

• Encode videos for any required format and uploading to media sources.

• Research and analyze best design techniques and solutions to create motion graphics.

• Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute creative ideas.

• Manage multiple projects and ensure that those are completed according to the stipulated timeframe while effectively applying our methodology and following quality standards.

 Your skills and competencies:

• Experience working as a motion designer 3+ years

• Solid experience with AI motion-design tools and the ability to create high-quality animations

• Proven motion graphics and video editing experience

• Professional proficiency in Adobe After Effects, working with plugins, and expressions. Creating 3D and 2D visual effects, and has good tracking, keying, and color correction skills. Confident use of Blender, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, Cinema 4D and Figma

• Availability of a strong portfolio showcasing work and demonstrating a wide range of motion graphics skills

• Knowledge of the basics of graphic design, principles of animation, composition, and typography

• Working with shadowing and light 

• Ability to work with guidelines and brand books

• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team

• Excellent attention to details, communication and collaboration skills

 We Offer:

• Fully remote job - work from anywhere you want

• Flexible working hours

• Competitive compensation

• 28 paid days off per year

• 3 paid sick days a year without medical certificate

• Reimbursement for sports & gym

• Software purchase support

• Real career opportunities and professional growth

• The great team across the world
